card.name: Ant in receptor antagonist headings
card.fires_on: The first piece " Ant" of the word antagonist, right after a receptor or adrenergic class name such as Alpha Adrenergic, Beta-Adrenergic Receptor, or Dopamine D2 Receptor. It appears in drug interaction section headings.
